description: Muri kino gice, turabona ukuntu abantu basabigwa ikigongwe. Umuherezi mukuru yabanza kwitangira ikimazi ciwe n’umuryango wiwe akabona gutanga ibimazi vy’abandi. Uno musi umuherezi mukuru dufise ari we Yesu, yinjiye ahera cane ajanye ayiwe maraso. Ayo niyo twogamwo tugakira ivyaha vyacu tukemerwa imbere y’Imana. Nkuko izo Mpene zikorera ivyaha vy’abantu niko na Yesu Kristo yikoreye ivyaha vyacu.
name: -Ingene ahantu abaherezi bakorera hategurwa n’ingene abantu bavyifatamwo

description: Muri kino gice Imana yerekanako ivyagezwe ari vyo shingiro ry’ubuzima bwabo. Imana rero yarihanikirije icaha c’ubusambanyi uko bwosa kwose, itako iravuga ibihano bazohanwa hamwe bosambana. Uyu musi hoho umenga ubusambanyi burashigikiwe ariko umenye ko bwatikije amahanga menshi.
name: Amahano Imana yahaye abisilayeri kubw’icaha c’ubusambanyi.

description: Imana yasezeraniye Abisirayeli imigisha ni yo babandanya bubaha; ari ko ntivyaboroheye barayivuyeko bikwegera igihano. Natwe uyu musi twahawe imigisha muri Kristo Yesu, ariko iyo migisha turashobora kuyizibira iyo tugiye mu caha.
name: Amasezerano y’umugisha kubazokwubahiriza ivyagezwe vy’Imana; Amasezerano y’amahano kubazokwanka kwubaha Imana.

description: Amasezerano nayo umuntu ashira imbere y’Imana atagahato, kandi ni meza. Umuntu yakijijwe akwiye kugira ico akoreye Imana kuko nayo ivyo idukorera ni vyinshi. Ico umuntu yomenya nuko iyo umuntu asezeranye bica bimufata nk’itegeko. N’ukuraba rero mugusezerana usezerane ico ushobora gushitsa kuko hagusezerana ntushitse wotuma ubura ico usezerana.
name: Gushitsa amasezerano

description: Aha Imana cane cane yihanikiriza Abisilayeri kudakora ivyaha nk’ivy’abo yari ikuye mu gihugu yari ibajanyemwo, ibasaba kuba abera kuko nayo ari iyera. Uku kwera rero kuraba abaherezi kukaraba n’abisilayeri bose. Abaherezi ntibakora ku mivyimba kiretse abo mu muryango. N’uno musi abakozi b’Imana hariho ivyo batemererwa kwisukamwo kuko vyobatera agasembwa, ariko umuryango ufise ikibanza gikomeye.
name: Ibihano Imana yashinze kubw’ivyaha bimwe bimwe n’ingene abaherezi bategerezwa kwirinda ako kose kobanduza.

description: Igitabo c’Abalewi cigisha ivyo guhimbaza no gusenga, kikerekana ukwera kw’Imana ikaba yashikirwa n.umuntu abanje gutanga ikimazi, akezwa. Ivyo bikaba vyari ikigereranyo c’ibizoba mu gihe ca Kristo.
name: Ibikuru bikuru vyo mu gitabo c’Abalewi

description: Umuntu wese canke ikoraniro ry.abantu uhereye ku muherezi iyo yakoze icaha yategerezwa kugitangira ikimazi, ikibanza umuntu yaba afise mu burongozi catuma hatorwa igikoko gitangirwa icaha ciwe, Ivyo bimazi vyose vyari igitutu ca Yesu Kristo ikimazi gikuraho ivyaha vy’abari mw’isi
name: Ibimazi vyo gitangirwa ivyaha

description: Mu ntumbero yo kurinda Abisirayeli indwara ziva kuvyo bariye canke bakozeko, Imana yarabatandukanirije ibikoko vyo mu mazi, mu nyoni no mu tunyonyera bikwiye kuribwa n’ibizira, ababuza no gukora ku mivyimba yavyo.
name: Ibizira n’ibitazira kuribwa mu bikoko vyo mu mazi, mu nyoni no mu dukoko tundi.

description: Umuntu ntaba umunyavyaha kuko yakoze ku kizira ariko ni umunyavyaha kubw’icaha yavukanye. Umugore yavyaye yamara igihe ahumanye kikarangizwa no kwitangira ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha. Umuntu wese ahindurwa uwutagira icaha kubw’ikimazi Yesu yatanze ku musaraba.
name: Icaha c’iragi n’ukuvuka uri umunyavyaha.

description: Igisokoro yari ingwara ifatiye ku gihimba c’irondoka aho umuntu ajejeta amashira. Ico umunyagisokoro yicarako cose caba gihumanye. N’icaha kirashobora gutuma umuntu asohora canke avuga ibintu bibi biva mu mutima wiwe vyogereranywa n’amashira. Icigwa nyamukuru n’uko Imana itagomba na gatoya yuko umuntu yaremwe mw’ishusho yayo aguma ahumanye, iyo bishitse agahumana asabwa kwakira Yesu Kristo kugira ngo ahumanuke.
name: Igisokoro canke igihumanya kiva mu mubiri w’umuntu kigereranywa n’icaha canduza.

description: Ikimasa n.umwagazi w.intama vyerekana igikorwa ca Kristo nk.umukunzi w.abantu hamwe n’incungu yabo, ibinure vyose bizoba ivy.Imana hamwe n’amaraso kuko Imana itegerezwa guhabwa ivyiza kurusha ibindi amaraso nayo akaba ari yo atweza.
name: Ikimazi c.ishimwe n.ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha.

description: Abaherezi bakira amashikanwa yose abantu batanze bakayashira ku gicaniro. Uwagunze yasabwa kandi gutanga indishi y’akababaro kandi Uhoraho yarabwiye Mose ngo na we abwire Aroni ingene ategerezwa kubigenza mur’ico gikorwa co gutanga ibimazi bitandukanye.
name: Ikimazi ku caha c.ubugunge, amabwirizwa yo ku kimazi coswa, ku vy.ishikanwa ry.amafu n.ayo ku kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha

description: Imisi mikuru Imana yahaye Abisilayeri yari imisi mikuru y’umunezero. Iyo misi mikuru yarahuza abantu bo mu miryango 12 y’Abisirayeli, yatuma abantu bava iyo bari bari, bakaza bagasengera hamwe, bagahanahana n’ibidandazwa. Ikindi iyo misi mikuru yari ijanye n’ubuhanuzi Imana yahaye abana bayo bwerekeye ibizoba. Bimwe biramaze gushitswa ibindi na vyo biracarindiriye gushika. Uyu musi ntitwategerezwa guhimbaza iyo misi mikuru kuko ukuza kwa mbere kwa Yesu Kwashikije vyose vyarimwo.
name: Imisi mikuru Uhoraho yahaye abisilayeri.

description: Uwutanze ikimazi yashira ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’ico atanze nk’ikimenyetso co kugishira kw’ivyaha vyiwe kigapfa mu gishingo ciwe. Ico cari igitutu c’ingene Kristo yishwe ashizwe kw’ivyaha vyacu. Amashikanwa y’ifu na yo ahishura Yesu nk’uwutagira icaha.
name: Ingene n’igituma hatangwa ikimazi co kwoswa

description: Umuntu wese yarobanurirwa igikorwa c’Imana yategerezwa kwuhagirwa ngo kibe ikmenyetso co kwezwa imbere y’Imana. Ni ko n’uyu musi umukozi w’Imana akwiye kubikora atagira ijwi rimwagiriza ikibi. Mpwemu yera ni we atwoza mw’Ijambo no mu maraso ya Yesu, tukambara ukugororoka kwiwe.
name: Irobanurwa ry’abaherezi n’ukwuhagirwa kwabo, Aroni n.abaherezi bozwa n.amaraso y.ibimazi.

description: Ifu igogoretse yategerezwa gusukiranywa n’amavuta ya Elayo bitanzwe ku muriro bigahinduka umubabwe umota neza. abalewi nabo barakamata kuri iyo fu bakarya nk’ikimenyetso co kwifatanya n’Imana nk’uko natwe duhamagarirwa kwifatanya na Kristo, ishikanwa ry’ishimwe na ryo ridushira hamwe muri Kristo
name: Ivy’amashikanwa y’amafu n’ibimazi vyishimwe

description: Ibikorwa vyose bikwiye kurongorwa na Mpwemu Yera bigakorerwa mu muco w’Imana. Kandi abantu nibo bategerezwa kuzana amavuta y’itara n’ifu yo gucumbamwo imitsima. Aho rero Imana yagomba kubumvisha ko ibikorwa ari ivyabo. N’uno musi Imana iragomba gukorana natwe no kutwereka ko ibikorwa ari ivyacu.
name: Ivy’itara ryo mw’ihema, ivy’imitsima y’ibiterekerwa n’igihano c’uwarogose kw’izina ry’Uhoraho.

description: Abagore bari mu butinyanka barakumirwa. Ingwara nyinshi zifatira mu bihimba vy’irondoka ziri mu zisinzikaza abantu kuko abantu bazinyegeza bazita iziteye isoni. Amu vyaha bikunda kunyegezwa, ibijanye n’ubusambanyi birimwo. Mugenzi icaha ico arico cose gikwiye gushirwa ahabona kikihanwa kuko kizana urupfu..Mu gice ca16 c’abalewi cerekana ukwitegura kw’umuherezi, ingene bategura aho guhererereza n’ingene abantu bitegura. N’uno musi umuntu w’Imana canke umukozi w’Imana akwiye kwama yiyejeje.
name: Ivy’uguhumana bijanye n’imiziro y’abagore.Umusi mukuru w’impongano

description: Umuherezi yategerezwa kuba uwejejwe kandi akaba utagira agasembwa, N’ikimazi n’uko categerezwa kuba kitagira agasembwa. N’uno musi, umukozi w’Imana akwiye kwirinda muri vyose akiyeza kugira igikorwa c’Imana ntigitukwe. Iyo umuntu w’Imana akoze ikosa atukisha Imana n’Ishengero.
name: Ivyaboneka nk’agasembwa ku muherezi bigatuma aba utemewe n’Imana n’ingene abaherezi bategerezwa kwirinda muri vyose

description: Abisilayeri bakiva muri Egiputa Imana yabahaye amabwirizwa akomeye kugirango abantu ntibahave bapfa gukererera ibitungwa ahatari ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Kwari ukugira ngo habe urutonde, abantu ntibahave bahereza ibimazi ibigirwamana. Ntivyari vyemewe kurya amaraso y’ibikoko kuko ubugingo bw’igikoko buri mu maraso. Ariko Yesu we avuga ati udya umubiri wanje akanywa amaraso yanje niwe afise ubugingo budashira.
name: Ivyagezwe bishinga ahantu ibimazi vyategerezwa gukerererwa.

description: Mu gushira ho umwaka w’isabato, Imana yagomba ko abantu baruhuka. Kandi Imana ntiyagomba ko abantu bigungirako isi. Imana yagomba gukingira isi n’aboro. Umwaka wa yubire wari umusi w’umunezero. Abantu baca bidegemvya , bagasubizwa mu vyabo. Uko ni ko natwe twidegemvya muri Kristo Yesu. Yesu yaducunguye ngo tuve mu buja bwa Satani.
name: Ivyagezwe Imana yahaye abisilayeri ku vy’umwaka w’Isabato n’umwaka wa Yubire.

description: Imana ihamagarira abantu kwezwa; no kwica uwacumuye cane cane uwashikaniye moreki (ikigirwamana) abana, guhamagara imizimu, kuvuma abavyeyi hamwe n’ubusambanyi kugira ngo ubuhumane burandurwe kandi n’abantu bakingirwe.
name: Ivyagezwe Imana yatanze kugira ngo baze binjire igihugu ca Isilayeli bejejwe.

description: Imana ico yagomba ku Bisilayeli ari co idushakako na twebwe uyu musi n’ukuba abera kuko Uhoraho Imana yacu ari uwera.
name: Ivyagezwe Imana yatanze kugira ngo mu mibano ntihabe ingorane.

description: Umuherezi mu gutanga ibimazi ivy’ari vyo vyose yisunga imigenzo yagezwe n’Uhoraho abicishije kuri Mose kandi kimwe kimwe cose mu vyakorwa cari igitutu c’ibizoba mu gihe c’Isezerano Rishasha.
name: Ivyagezwe ku bimazi vy’impongano, ivy’ishimweamabwirizwa yo ku binure, amaraso n’ibindi

description: Umunyamibembe amaze gutangirwa ibimazi yarahumanuka akemerwa mu bandi, akimosha akongera akiyuhagira. Iyo migenzo yerekana ko ubuzima bwiwe bwa kera burangiye none agiye gutangura ubuzima bushasha. Iyo umuntu aje kuri Yesu Kristo haba uguhinduka mu bugingo bwiwe ivya kera akabihebe agakora ivy’ukugororoka.
name: Ivyagezwe ku vyo guhumanura umunyamibembe

description: Umunyamibembe yashirwa ukwa wenyene kugira ntiyanduze abandi. Amaze gukira canke guhumanuka yaca asubizwa mu bandi. Aha rero twigishwa ukuri kw’ivy’impwemu gufatanije no guhumanurwa kw’imibembe nk’ikigereranyo c’icaha.
name: Ivyagezwe vyo ku Mibembe

description: Ingene basuzuma umunyamibembe n’ibimenyetso bimwerekana; ingene yakurwa mu bandi n’ingene yasubizwamwo.
name: Ivyagezwe vyo ku Mibembe 2

description: Gusuzuma ingwara y’Imibembe ntivyagarukira ku rukoba gusa ariko n’impuzu canke ikintu cose kija ku mubiri carasuzumwa basanze caranduye caraturirwa. Niko biri, n’umwadujwe n’icaha akeneye kwozwa n’amaraso ya Yesu. Imibembe yari ingwara iteye ubwoba ariko yarakira. Eka n’icaha nuko nta caha kidaharirwa.
name: Ivyagezwe vyo ku Mibembe 3

description: Icaha icari co cose gikozwe umuntu yavyiyumviriye canke ahurudutse amaze kugitahuzwa yategerezwa kucatura no kugitangira ikimazi. Hejuru y’ico kimazi mu gihe hari ico yagunze umuntu canke Imana yategerezwa kukiriha ikigeretseko n’indishi y’akababaro.
name: Ivyaha bimwe n.ibimazi bitangirwa ,ibimazi vy.impongano

description: Abisirayeli Imana yarabatoranirije ivyari bibereye kuribwa n’ibitari bibereye kuko yagomba kubarinda ivyokwonona ubuzima bwabo. Uku ni ko Imana igomba ko haba akarimbi hagati y’ikibi n’iciza, hagati y’umuco n'umwiza. Dusabwa guhitamwo iciza tukanka ibibi.
name: Ivyo Abisirayeli bari bemerewe kurya nivyo batari bemerewe

description: Aroni n’abaherezi barobanujwe amavuta n’amaraso nk’ikimenyetso co guharirwa ivyaha no gusirwa na Mpwemu yera. Imbere yo gutangura igikorwa Aroni yabanje kwitangira ikimazi ku vyaha vyiwe. Kristo we nta kimazi yarinze kwitangira kuko ata caha yigeze akora.
name: Kwinjizwa kw’abaherezi mu gikorwa, amabwirizwa yahawe Aroni n’abana biwe.

description: Umugararizo no kutumvira kw.abana ba Aroni vyabakwegeye gupfa. Uko niko umuntu wese acumura ku Mana azopfa n.atihana. Mose yaboneyeho akaryo ko kubaca amahani ngo baze bame bitondera ivyo Imana yageze kuko bose bari bagize ubwoba.
name: Nadabu na Abibu binjira mu kibanza c’umuherezi ata ruhusha bibazanira gupfa.
